lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular spots located posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately four discernible horizontal rows with increasing inter-spot distance towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance run perpendicular to the body axis, intersecting with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a coordinate-like grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A horizontal linear feature is visible along the dorsal-lateral interface, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the upper ridge and a soft shadow on the lower margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of significantly smaller, irregular high-luminance spots is visible on the anterior region and extending onto the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
